subject.title: Sidebar session groups cannot be renamed, deleted, kept empty, or turned off

question: Should sidebar group management proceed through the linked Control UI-only PR, or should maintainers choose a different UX/API direction before implementation?
rationale: The issue requests new visible UI controls and a new persisted browser preference, carries a protected maintainer label, and already has an open linked PR, so maintainer intent should choose the accepted product shape.

options.title: Review the linked PR
options.body: Rebase and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101117 as the implementation path, including the pagination repair already identified there.

options.title: Redesign before coding
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask for a different sidebar group-management UX or a gateway-owned bulk operation before accepting code.

options.title: Decline sidebar group management
options.body: Close this issue and the linked PR only if maintainers decide sidebar groups should remain lightweight and row-managed.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR
recommendation.body: Rebase and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101117 as the implementation path, including the pagination repair already identified there.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the issue, the linked PR, and the recent merged sidebar/session-grouping feature history.
